records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The accompanying interim unaudited, consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States ("GAAP") for interim financial information and with the instructions to Form 10-Q and Rule 10-01 of Regulation S-X. These interim unaudited, consolidated financial statements contain all adjustments (consisting of normal recurring accruals) necessary to present fairly our financial position as of March 31, 2022 and our results of operations and cash flows for the three months ended March 31, 2022 and 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: It is not customary business practice to extend payment terms past 90 days, and as such, we do not have a practice of including a significant financing component within our contracts with customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Amounts for credit losses charged to expense, before recoveries, during the three months ended March 31, 2022 and 2021 were $54 and $41 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Contract assets related to in-transit packages were $336 and $304 million as of March 31, 2022 and December 31, 2021, respectively, net of deferred revenue related to in-transit packages of $359 and $314 million as of March 31, 2022 and December 31, 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Short-term contract liabilities related to advance payments from customers were $10 and $27 million as of March 31, 2022 and December 31, 2021, respectively.
